camel_example: aliyun cas CreateDeploymentJob --region cn-hangzhou --JobType user --CertIds '12342649,12304338,12067351,9957285' --ResourceIds '6591316,6585549,6190248,5811894,5775176,5772504' --Name jobName --ContactIds '1,2'
description_en: Creates certificate deployment tasks to deploy issued SSL certificates to Alibaba Cloud or third-party cloud services. You can run the tasks immediately or at a specified time to provide trusted identity authentication and secure data transmission for your websites
description_zh: SSL证书签发完成后，您可以通过该接口创建不同类型的证书部署任务，立即或手动指定任务部署时间，将SSL证书部署到阿里云产品或三方云产品，为您的业务网站提供可信身份认证和安全数据传输
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-deployment-job --name jobName --job-type user --cert-ids 12342649,12304338,12067351,9957285 --resource-ids 6591316,6585549,6190248,5811894,5775176,5772504 --contact-ids 1,2 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDeploymentJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the deployment task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The certificate IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The ID is the CertificateId returned by https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html
parameters.help_zh: 证书ID，多个证书ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html返回的**CertificateId**
parameters.name: cert_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the cloud service resources. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The ID is the primary key Id returned by https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html.

https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html returns the existing cloud infrastructure resources (such as SLB, ALB, CDN, WAF, and DCDN instances) under your account. Certificate Management Service does not provide operations to create these resources. You must create the resources by using the API operations (such as CreateLoadBalancer) or the console of the corresponding cloud service before you can query them by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html and use them in this operation
parameters.help_zh:
云产品资源ID。多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html返回的主键**Id**。

 ListCloudResources 返回的是账号下已有的云产品基础设施（SLB、ALB、CDN、WAF、DCDN 等实例），CAS 不提供创建这些资源的接口，需要先通过对应云产品的 API（如 CreateLoadBalancer 等）或控制台预先创建资源后才能在 ListCloudResources 中查到并用于本接口
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The contact IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The ID is the primary key Id returned by https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712221.html
parameters.help_zh: 联系人ID。多个联系人ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712221.html返回的主键**Id**
parameters.name: contact_ids

parameters.help_en: The time when the task is scheduled to start. The value is a UNIX timestamp. If you do not specify this parameter, the deployment is immediately executed when the task enters the pending execution state
parameters.help_zh: 设置任务开始调度的时间（Unix时间戳）。如果不设置，在任务处于待执行状态时将立即执行部署
parameters.name: schedule_time

JobId.description_en: The ID of the deployment task

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
